Palmetto Estates is a census-designated place (CDP) in Miami-Dade County, Florida, United States. The population was 13,675 at the 2000 census.


== Geography ==
Palmetto Estates is located at 25°37′11″N 80°21′42″W (25.619782, -80.361752).According to the United States Census Bureau, the CDP has a total area of 2.2 square miles (5.7 km2), of which, 2.1 square miles (5.4 km2) of it is land and 0.04 square miles (0.10 km2) of it (0.93%) is water.
